f.n: Bach Long Vi Ecological Rehabilitation Zone (Buffer Zone)
f.pu: To conserve marine biodiversity for the sake of sustainbale development, as well as to serve the scientific research activities, sightseeing, eco-tourism. The MPA aims to preserve the ecosystems of coral, seaweed, sea grass, and breeding ground of aquatic plants and living resources in the area.
f.re: The following is prohibited: 1.The exploitation of living and non-living resources by any method and means; 2. Aquaculture; 3. Discharge of waste and wastewater; 4. All activities on coral reefs and seagrass areas.

f.n: Bach Long Vi Strict Protection Zone (Core Zone)
f.pu: To conserve marine biodiversity for the sake of sustainbale development, as well as to serve the scientific research activities, sightseeing, eco-tourism. The MPA aims to preserve the ecosystems of coral, seaweed, sea grass, and breeding ground of aquatic plants and living resources in the area.
f.re: The following is prohibited: 1. The exploitation of living and non-living resources by any method and means; 2. Aquaculture; 3. Vessels; 4. Discharge of waste and wastewater; 5. All activities on coral reefs and seagrass areas.
